scope: R2 implementation verification only; no scientific selector, orbit bytes, R2 graph semantics, DEM, R3/R4 rule, window, pair, imputation, or territorial rule changes

diagnostic_sources_allowed: frozen execution contract graph paths and hashes
diagnosis: the v0.1 cache proof incorrectly pinned one UTM18 R2 graph although the pre-existing execution contract freezes a distinct UTM17 graph for san_ildefonso
the v0.1 cache scanner treated two path instances of the same approved basename as two resources even when byte-identical, so exact SNAP cache materialization could fail the proof
one shard exposed that the runtime installer can report RUNTIME_METADATA_GATE_FAIL_CLOSED while returning process code zero; the workflow must enforce the report status before R2

allowed_consumption_proof.name: CLEAN_USER_HOME_EXACT_POEORB_CACHE_IDENTITY_EXCLUSIVITY_AND_HARD_APPLY_ORBIT_GATE_V02
requirements_all_mandatory: the runtime graph path and SHA-256 must match exactly one graph already frozen for the unit in the pre-existing PRIMARY6 execution contract
the side-specific POEORB ZIP is independently downloaded and SHA-256/byte-count/inner-EOF verified against the frozen v0.2 prerequisite before preseed
before each side, the exact verified ZIP is copied to the deterministic SNAP14 POEORB cache path and its SHA-256 is reverified
every AUX_POEORB basename anywhere under the clean user.home orbit cache must be an approved exact resource for the current or already introduced side of the same pair
multiple filesystem paths with the same approved AUX_POEORB basename are allowed only when every copy is byte-identical to the single frozen SHA-256 for that basename
the same basename appearing with different bytes is an immediate failure
GPT returns zero and the side output exists
after GPT, no unapproved AUX_POEORB basename may exist anywhere under the clean user.home orbit cache
the exact side ZIP remains byte-identical after GPT
stdout/stderr must contain no AUX_POEORB filename different from an exact frozen side resource
the selected frozen graph must retain orbitType=Sentinel Precise (Auto Download) and continueOnFail=false
the workflow runtime-install report must independently be PASS before R2 execution
allowed_consumption_proof.identity_semantics: resource identity is basename plus frozen SHA-256; duplicate path instances of one byte-identical approved resource do not constitute an alternative orbit resource
allowed_consumption_proof.pass_semantics: when all requirements pass, exact canonical POEORB consumption is implementation-verified even if SNAP14 emits no orbit filename because the resource was satisfied from its local cache
allowed_consumption_proof.fail_semantics: any unapproved basename, differing hash for an approved basename, missing exact ZIP, nonzero GPT exit, missing output, graph not frozen for PRIMARY6, graph semantic change, or runtime-install non-PASS remains BLOCKED
allowed_consumption_proof.legacy_log_request_rule: an exact filename explicitly logged by SNAP14 remains valid positive evidence; local-cache identity proof is an additional implementation proof route, not a scientific selector change
